note: Kansas State Parks area on a wooded peninsula on the east shore of Tuttle Creek Lake, beside the marina: primitive camping off the area's loop roads, four cabins and the Deer Hill shelters. KDWP's park page gives both 50 and 100 primitive sites. --Claude

Not waterfront stands; pin kept (pads not visible); count left unset (KDWP contradicts itself).
